_comment: The files of this catalog written for people, read by the writing check of the OtoDock repository (scripts/prose/prose_check.py there, whose WRITING.md is the rules page). A markdown file no group claims and no entry excludes fails the check.

skip.version: it names the release that reads each manifest field

CONTRIBUTING.md.phrase: Not installed; NOT in any catalog
CONTRIBUTING.md.reason: the preflight check's message, quoted as the platform writes it

excluded.*/agent.md: the agent's persona, which the agent reads
excluded.*/prompt.md: a copy of the persona, which the agent reads
excluded.*/setup.md: a setup guide the agent reads and walks a manager through
excluded.*/user-setup.md: an onboarding guide the agent reads and walks each user through
excluded.*/apps/**: an app's own files, which the agent and the app read
excluded.*/user-apps/**: an app's own files, which the agent and the app read
excluded.*/checks/**: a check's own files, which the check reads
excluded.CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md: the Contributor Covenant, as its authors wrote it
